output.action_text: Wire new Cursor hooks on 2-4+ — `stop`, `beforeSubmitPrompt`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse` — at https://cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks. `beforeSubmitPrompt` lets you mutate the prompt; tool-use hooks gate tool execution; `stop` fires at the end of an agent run.
